vio: Basalt; identical frozen VIO input across GNSS conditions
evaluation: Horizontal antenna error in ENU, same 5 Hz evaluation timestamps, initial transform fixed; no evaluation SE(3) refit
initial_alignment: First 2 m of nominal simulated RTK sigma .02, yaw+translation fixed across cases; successful initialization assumed
gnss_noise: Gaussian noise in horizontal axes; no vertical noise in these controlled cases
limits: Synthetic GNSS, not hardware accuracy. Combined VIO drift and GNSS degradation remains a failure case. No successful VIO reinitialization claimed.
